intro: Can you set every slice straight?
description:
A lovely picture is in pieces, and every slice is facing the wrong way. Can you calmly put it back together?

It looks simple at first, but the more you play, the more those tiny visual clues start to matter.

This is a relaxed illustration puzzle where you rotate sliced pieces of a single image until the full picture returns to its proper shape.

・Check the whole illustration
・Rotate each slice to the right angle
・Restore the image before the timer gets away
・Aim for a three-star clear based on your time

There are no complicated rules to learn. Just look closely, trust your eye, and enjoy that satisfying moment when everything lines up.

Perfect for a short break or a cosy puzzle session. Why not take on the next image and see how quickly you can solve it?

Button controls and touch controls are both supported.
